newsitem.title: UK: London silver fixes firmer, eyes higher levels.
newsitem.headline: London silver fixes firmer, eyes higher levels.

text.p: SILVER - Fixed at 485.70 cents vs 472.25 cents previously. Borrowing rates sharply higher overnight and price at resistance. Scope for mid 490 cents if broken. GOLD - Firmer at $346.00/$346.50 and meeting some overhead selling. Resisting easier tone in PGMs. PLATINUM - Barely changed at $409.00/$412.00. PALLADIUM - Down about $3.50 at $186.00/$189.00.
